infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Hypa Intelligence uses your microphone when you tap the mic in the app or in the Hypa keyboard, to turn your speech into text or a translation. For example, if you say 'How much is this?', we record that clip, convert it to text, and return the translation.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Hypa Intelligence uses the camera when you take a photo for a chat, or when you point it at text with Lens to translate it, for example a sign, menu or receipt.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Hypa Intelligence uses your photos when you attach one to a Chat message.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Hypa Intelligence saves a picture to your photos only when you tap Save on it, for example an image Hypa made for you.
